activation: exact root review plan; existing controlled storage and ledger only
nativeUi: unchanged graph-bound ui-settings-memory factory and Connection routes

capture.effective: enabled only by explicit cold business.capture=true plus configured per-project switch; shared Profile model/budget guards apply
capture.verification: synthetic same-ledger extraction and failure limits; no paid model quality certification

close: bounded receipt; retain resources until actual settlement; fiber disposal joins settlement
notIncluded: complete Linux/macOS protected Profile and desktop certification
native Electron menu/IPC whole-application exit integration
mountFailure: UI assembly failure with incomplete cleanup returns a mounted, blocked recovery control within shutdownMs; never ready/active. Successful cleanup still rejects the original mount error. Trusted caller must inspect status, repair the cause, retry close, await whenClosed and dispose before a fresh mount.
hostOwnership: Dedicated controlled project host: close cancels every host Agent whose cwd is the selected projectRoot or a descendant, including agents not created by this composition. Do not mount in a shared project host without accepting that boundary.
toolSettlement: Requires fixed native Agent-loop/Tools scheduler final tools/result publication after tools/pre-execute, including cancellation/failure. A missing final event retains the pending token and lease; no forced release or whole-application shutdown deadline.
authentication: Generic controlled-installation SettingsUi relies on an authenticated Connection carrier. Explicit native-settings-installation fixture verifies signed cookie authority and Host/Origin fences; this does not certify every desktop carrier.
initializationFailure: Root-owned control is published before asynchronous initialization. Trusted startup supervision may use ctx.get(name,false) for a LOADING Cordis provider; business discovery stays strict. Incomplete rollback returns blocked, retains ownership, and supports close retry. No late ready/publication after close; whenClosed means actual release.
lifecycleOwner: One root fiber generation, not the reused Loader Entry or a recreated inner fiber. Dependency refresh cannot reopen a closed root; explicit dispose and a fresh root fiber may mount again.

historyExpansion.scope: explicit current direct user request; same registered project and same session; current revision/provenance and independent P2 deletion authority; maximum four calls; no automatic L4 search

paidMedia.scope: verified native image model capability and request pricing; native attachments in independent governed domain; existing Profile ledger; synthetic evidence only

localMedia: business.media defaults false; bounded UTF-8/digital PDF/DOCX extraction without a model call; audio/video not certified
verificationScope: fixedTestDefinitions and named counts below are historical baseline definition counts, not a new bundle24 total. Current evidence: docs/BUNDLE-REVIEW-REPAIR.json.
shutdownBridge: application-shutdown explicitly accepts a trusted dedicated host and official controller. Local synthetic application cases are verified separately; complete desktop quit wiring remains unverified.
failureDiagnostics: Trusted control status retains bounded code/errorType for initializationCause/mountCause, separately from cleanup code. No arbitrary message, stack, path or body. Blocked controls retain owners and permit explicit close retries; whenClosed means actual release.
consumerCleanup: Evaluation blocked-stop cannot skip independent memory/click/context cleanup. Successfully released children are not repeated; unfinished stop/dispose/layer close is retried. Evaluation fiber and root lease remain until its shutdown is confirmed. No forced backend kill is provided.
